description: Defines template classes and functions for managing plugin interfaces, including reference handling, interface creation, and builder pattern for plugin interface configuration within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceRef
classes.description: A smart reference wrapper for plugin interface pointers, managing reference counting and move semantics.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for configuring and creating plugin interface instances with specified parameters like callsign, version, timeout, and associated shell service.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns a plugin interface instance by querying the controller with a callsign.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: Utility function to create a std::unique_ptr for a given type with forwarded constructor arguments.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder::createInterface
methods.description: Creates a plugin interface using the configured builder parameters.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder::withVersion
methods.description: Sets the version for the plugin interface to be built.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder::withTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout value for the plugin interface.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder::withIShell
methods.description: Associates an IShell service with the plugin interface being built.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder::callSign
methods.description: Returns the callsign string used for identifying the plugin.
